function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content: I’m not able to take a picture myself, but I can definitely help you get one! If you’re using a smartphone or a webcam, just open your camera app (or the built‑in camera software) and point it at yourself. If you need step‑by‑step instructions or tips on lighting, framing, or editing, just let me know!
message.reasoning: The user says "take a pic of me". We need to interpret what they want. They might want us to take a picture of them. But we can't physically take a picture. We could ask them to use their camera or provide instructions. Or we could respond that we cannot take a picture. According to policy, we should not claim to have taken a picture. We can offer to guide them. So we should respond politely, explaining we can't physically take a picture, but we can help them do it. Also we can ask if they want instructions. There's no disallowed content. So we comply.
